text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down, but these short-term fluctuations do not tell me what prices will do next.","With no trades so far, I have avoided reacting to noise; I should still review whether my overall portfolio fits my goals rather than simply leaving it untouched by habit.","I should evaluate positions and decisions in the context of the whole portfolio, not anchor on each stock’s gain or loss since I bought it."]}
